scope: Human-reviewed reference guidance, not a live scrape of the Internet.

rules.title: I²C communication reference
rules.summary: An I²C reference may indicate communication problems involving one of several devices on a shared bus. The affected circuit and likely causes depend on the exact iPhone model and panic context.
rules.action: Compare the complete log, model and bus information with known-good hardware and service documentation before considering replacement.

rules.title: Storage controller reference
rules.summary: ANS2 references may concern NAND/storage communication, but the panic alone cannot distinguish a storage device, connection, system or logic-board cause.
rules.action: Protect customer data first; compare recurring logs and conduct appropriate storage/board diagnostics with a qualified technician.

rules.title: System-on-chip temperature/power reference
rules.summary: AppleSocHot is associated with a thermal or power-management concern. It does not independently prove overheating or identify a particular failed component.
rules.action: Check temperature, charging/thermal symptoms and board-level evidence using safe verified procedures.

notes: A matching reference is a lead for investigation, never a confirmed faulty part. Diagnostic rules are manually reviewed. New sources require verification and reuse permission.
